chunks: Al-Ḥusayn b. Muskān (peace be upon him)
I do not recognize him except that Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad b. Mālik narrated (corrupt) ḥadīths from him. There is no knowledge about this man amongst our companions.

key_terms.أَصْحَابِنَا: our companions (referring to the prominent early Shia narrators)
key_terms.عِلْمٌ: knowledge (in this context, known status or recognition)
key_terms.فَاسِدَةً: corrupt (referring to the quality of a hadith narrator or text)

ai.seo_question: Who is al-Husayn ibn Muskān and what is his status in hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry from the book of weak narrators (Kitab al-Du'afa) discusses al-Ḥusayn b. Muskān. The author notes that he is not widely recognized, except that Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad b. Mālik narrated weak (fāsidah) hadiths from him, and there is little known about him among the companions.
